name: application-label
title: Label
description: Standalone form label primitive with required asterisk, optional hint, disabled tone, and an info button slot for a tooltip trigger.
useWhen: You need just the label element — not a bundled control, help text, and error state.
Labeling a custom or third-party control that Form Row's built-in input slot doesn't fit.
You want a consistent required/optional marker or an info tooltip trigger next to any field label.
avoidWhen: The field also needs help text and error-state wiring with aria-describedby — use Form Row instead, which bundles all of that.
The control is a checkbox or radio where the label conventionally follows rather than precedes the control.
responsiveBehavior: The label is a single inline-flex line at all widths; the optional hint and info button share the line and wrap only if the container is extremely narrow.
accessibility: Always set htmlFor to the paired control's id so clicking the label focuses the control.
The required asterisk is aria-hidden; convey the requirement via the label text or form-level instructions for screen reader users.
The info button carries an aria-label describing its purpose since it has no visible text.

variants.title: Label
variants.description: Four label states: required with asterisk, optional with a trailing hint, with an info tooltip trigger, and disabled.
accessibility: Every label uses htmlFor pointing at its control's id, including the info-button variant.

variants.title: Label (Dark)
variants.description: The same four label states adapted for dark form surfaces.
accessibility: Disabled label tone still meets WCAG AA contrast against the dark surface to remain legible, not just decoratively muted.
